title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who engages in an unlawful act or practice that violates any provision of this chapter shall be fined not less than $500 or more than $2,500 for each unlawful act or practice.
bodyHtml: [§436M-10]  Penalty.  Any person who engages in an unlawful act or practice that violates any provision of this chapter shall be fined not less than $500 or more than $2,500 for each unlawful act or practice. [L 1986, c 134, pt of §1]
